A user has filed a support ticket reporting that their experience
with the service has degraded — requests feel slow or are failing
for them. The on-call team needs you to investigate.

Telemetry parquets are stored in: `.`
Available files: abnormal_metrics.parquet, abnormal_traces.parquet,
abnormal_logs.parquet, abnormal_metrics_histogram.parquet,
abnormal_metrics_sum.parquet, normal_metrics.parquet,
normal_traces.parquet, normal_logs.parquet.

Walk the telemetry to identify which endpoints / services are
actually affected, then determine the root cause(s) of the
degradation.

input.reflection: Tables: abnormal/normal traces, metrics, metrics_sum, histogram, logs. normal_logs is empty. Traces schema has service_name, duration, status code, http method/status, parent_span_id. Plan: compare per-service error rate and latency for abnormal vs normal traces; then look at per-endpoint (span_name) breakdown; then metrics for resource saturation.

input.query: SELECT 'abn' src, service_name, count(*) n, avg(duration)/1e6 avg_ms, quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6 p95_ms, sum(CASE WHEN attr_status_code='Error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) errs, sum(CASE WHEN attr_http_response_status_code>=500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) http5xx FROM abnormal_traces GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'norm' src, service_name, count(*), avg(duration)/1e6, quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6, sum(CASE WHEN attr_status_code='Error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), sum(CASE WHEN attr_http_response_status_code>=500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM normal_traces GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1

- **Failing:** `GET /recommendations` on `frontend`. All 171 HTTP 500s and all 342 error-status spans in the abnormal window come from this endpoint. Normal traces have zero errors.

- **Restart counter:** pod `recommendation-69bf88479c-jwhg7` climbs from 2 to 6 between 03:15:55 and 03:20:05. In the normal window it sits flat at 1.
